verdict.rationale: Composio's Triggers feature lets developers register events from connected apps (Slack message, GitHub commit, etc.) and receive them as signed webhook payloads, which is the event-detection half of an automation rule [composio-docs-9][composio-docs-21]. However, there's no evidence of a built-in rule/condition engine or automatic action execution inside Composio itself — the docs describe delivering the event to 'your webhook URL,' implying the user's own app must implement the trigger-to-action logic. Missing for 10: a documented rule/condition definition mechanism, evidence of Composio automatically invoking actions post-trigger without external code, and any hands-on confirmation that triggers reliably fire (community evidence only shows an unrelated connection failure).
